title: Learn which cloud models actually improve Susi from verified outcomes
goal: Feed verified self-development outcomes into Susi's evidence-ranked brain by task class and model: accepted/rejected patch, exact test receipts, regression metrics, latency, cost, availability failure and reviewer disagreement. Keep operational unavailability distinct from implementation quality. Persist failure counterexamples and rejection reasons; repeated proposals must address them or provide fresh evidence. Do not reward self-reported success or tune against held-out checks. Use these outcomes for future implementer/reviewer assignments while continuing to exclude currently nonworking models. Hermetic tests prove rankings respond to verified improvement and rejected candidates do not earn success evidence. Implement nonzero tests named cloud_rsi_outcomes_* in susi-gawd exercising production wiring.
